items.title: Billy Bauer interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, March 22, 1998
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] ...was it Lester Young or let’s see Buddy Tate, those fellas? [INTERVIEWEE] You mean playing in these places?

ctx.x: Yeah. Hi jiving. And he says, like they say, that offay, he says, that means you.
What kind of fellas, for the Basie band — was it Lester Young or let’s see Buddy Tate, those fellas?
You mean playing in these places?
